function.name: rhd_sub_chat_await
function.description: Wait for a subchat you spawned from this chat to finish. This call holds until the subchat completes, then returns its final assistant message content verbatim. Prefer it over polling rhd_sub_chat_status. Only direct children of the current chat can be awaited. There is no timeout: a subchat parked on an error keeps this call pending until an operator fixes it.

chatId.description: Id of the subchat, as reported by rhd_sub_chat
